card.question: At the N3 rules set on 2026-10-24 and the expected 16/4 split, which designs can read Continue or Stop, and can N2's registered gates still read Continue?
card.answer: At map-baseline correlation 0.6, a true gain of 0.20 continues with P = 0.622 at 3 x 20 areas (16/4) and 0.855 at 5 x 20; a null stops with P <= 0.481 up to 6 x 20, and P >= 0.8 needs 80 areas per gold (SYNTHETIC). E-PLANT's best reachable reading is Change.
card.changed: Proposed minimum design keyed to the map-baseline correlation measured before gold: 5 golds of 20 areas if it is at least 0.6, 5 of 30 if at least 0.3; gold items per area leaves K; no E-PLANT floor amendment.

worked: Stand-ins fail as required: random P(Continue) <= 0.008, size+noise <= 0.004; false Continue <= 0.039 at c = 1.85.
failed: Planted gain 0.20 misses P(Continue) >= 0.8 in 70 of 552 cells at DS3's minority floor 25 (min 0.532).
